title: Skill eval suite
description: Test cases for one skill. Consumed by scripts/run-evals.py (offline routing + coverage gates) and by any LLM-graded with-skill/baseline harness.

must_cover.description: Literal technical anchors (API fields, tool names, named patterns) the SKILL.md body must contain for its assertions to be satisfiable. A miss is a content gap.

cases.description: At least 3 should-trigger and 2 should-not-trigger cases, phrased as a real user would type them.

files.description: Relative paths to fixture files the case depends on (assets/).

assertions.description: Behavioural statements about a correct response. Graded by an LLM grader; must discriminate against a no-skill baseline.

known_residual.description: Justification for a case that fails the offline routing gate for a defensible reason (e.g. a genuine near-tie with a sibling skill). Reported every run but does not fail the gate. Requires review; never use it to paper over a weak description.
